news.title: McDonald's Drives the Dow Drop
news.summary: McDonald's stock was on track for its worst day in more than six years on Wednesday, taking the Dow Jones Industrial Average lower.  It was down as much as 6.5% in what could be McDonald's largest single-day decline since March 2020.  McDonald's was a roughly 76-point drag on the Dow.
